commits.message:
A window over wider content moves with time: scroll, marquee and slide (rich-animation-42lg.re8) (#488)

* A window over wider content moves with time: scroll, marquee and slide (rich-animation-42lg.re8)

scroll(content, { width, height, col, row }) is an Animation<Renderable>
of a fixed slot over content drawn at its natural size, each offset an
Animation<number>. frameAt now draws any renderable's animation with its
cells stamped at the host's time.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* A scroll draws its content at its natural width, crops to its room, and refuses a non-finite offset; one stamped frame (rich-animation-42lg.re8)

Review (high) of PR #488: content drawn at maxWidth Infinity threw on a Rule;
the slot spilled past a narrower room; a NaN offset drew a blank slot.
LifecycleFrame folded into frameAt's Stamped, so the stamp wrapper has one copy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* A scroll keeps a cell-less frame's change stamp left of its window; the demo's slide comes from the left as it says (rich-animation-42lg.re8)

Review (medium) of PR #488.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* A scroll's frame carries the soonest change of all its content, and draws content of no width (rich-animation-42lg.re8)

Escalation review (high) of PR #488: the left-of-window filter missed rows above
and below and cells to the right, and leaked combining marks; content of natural
width 0 was held at maxWidth 0 and drew no stamp.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
